question: At the same focal year, current reproductive success and prior total successes, does the ORDER of earlier successes/failures add genuinely independent next-year predictive information beyond fixed bird quality, age/year effects and detection?

source_context.already_fit: 1997–2013, 3089 known-age birds, 9603 breeding observations; individual identity, year and colony effects, age first breeding, selective appearance/disappearance and experience already analyzed
source_context.do_not_claim_novelty: Adding an individual random intercept and year effects is prior art, not the proposed contribution
source_context.author_advice: Contact study team before deep novel individual-sequence reanalysis; IDs recoded and may not be linked with other author papers

equal_properties: future prediction is for a next observed event

preexposed_mathematical_null_models.N0_FIXED_QUALITY_IID: Latent high/low lifetime success propensities, independent conditional on lifelong type; same number of successes and attempts imply exactly same next prediction regardless of order
preexposed_mathematical_null_models.N1_FIXED_QUALITY_PLUS_SHARED_YEAR_SHOCK: logit p_(i,t) = alpha_quality_i + beta_year_t; with same set of attempted years and number of successes, posterior latent alpha is identical across order permutations even when year probabilities change, but historical sequence frequencies differ
preexposed_mathematical_null_models.N2_QUALITY_BY_YEAR_INTERACTION_NO_MEMORY: Different lifetime phenotypes respond differently to the same year; same-count order can change inferred latent type and future prediction WITHOUT any outcome-to-outcome causal carryover
preexposed_mathematical_null_models.N3_TRUE_LAGGED_PROCESS: A direct older-outcome effect could also generate order-dependent future forecasts; N2 and N3 remain observationally indistinguishable without extra assumptions/data

test_constraints: All calculations purely synthetic exact probabilities, no animal records
For iid frailty and shared additive logits, same history count must yield identical posterior and future predictions to numerical precision
For a nonadditive stable-type-by-year response, synthetic order difference must arise although each year is independent conditional on type, thus disproving general identifiability
Evaluate true old-state effect only as a competing synthetic model, never as observed penguin biology
New biological outcome reading or fitting remains explicitly HOLD until original author source, quality history and detection treatment validated

Prospective empirical design would require confirmed at-risk attempt seasons (not zeros for unobserved or skipping), same age/year/colony, enough identical-count histories with different order, and year-held-out predictive validation plus posterior predictive null simulations
Any effect in one Ross Island colony or three clustered Ross Island colonies is NOT an inter-island replicated mechanism
prior_art: Individual heterogeneity, age, first-recruitment and selective disappearance included by Kappes et al 2021; older multistate effects and GOF reported Lescroel et al 2009. Exchangeability/conditional models standard statistics, not original theory
